author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mcp-server-ts
title: MCP server with TypeScript
description: An MCP server ready to connect to Claude, Cursor or any agent: tools typed with Zod, stdio transport and the official inspector to try it out.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each tool is registered in `src/tools.ts` with `server.registerTool(name, { description, inputSchema }, handler)`. The description is what the model reads: say what it does and when to use it.
- Validate input with Zod and return useful errors as text (`isError: true`), not exceptions.
- **stdout is the protocol**: never use `console.log`; write to stderr to debug.
- Test with `npm run build && npm run inspect` (opens the MCP inspector).
- To use it in Claude Code: `claude mcp add {{name}} -- node $(pwd)/dist/index.js`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
